mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM role r INNER JOIN user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id and ur.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_role (user_id, role_id, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND role_id = #{roleId}
